name: Generate Image
description: Generate an image from a text description and save it in the workspace. The picture is shown to the user automatically. Write the prompt in English and describe subject, setting, style and lighting explicitly — the image model is not the one reading this conversation and knows nothing about it.

prompt.description: What to draw, in English. Be concrete and visual: subject, action, setting, art style, lighting, colours.

negative_prompt.description: What must NOT appear in the image (e.g. 'text, watermark, extra fingers'). Optional.

width.description: Image width in pixels. Leave unset to use the configured default; most models want a multiple of 64.

height.description: Image height in pixels. Leave unset to use the configured default.

steps.description: Denoising steps. More is slower and usually cleaner; turbo/lightning models want very few (1-8). Leave unset for the configured default.

seed.description: Random seed. Reuse the same seed with the same prompt to get the same image back; omit or -1 for a new one.

filename.description: Base name for the saved file, without extension. Optional: one is derived from the prompt.
